title: Pater, ait
html_source:
Latin. “Father! he cries”

The cry of terror issued by Icarus as he falls.

anchor.prefix:
ur fantastical humour. 

 Me, Magee and Mulligan. 

 Fabulous artificer. The hawklike man. You flew. Whereto? Newhaven-Dieppe, steerage passenger. Paris and back. Lapwing. Icarus.
anchor.suffix:
. Seabedabbled, fallen, weltering. Lapwing you are. Lapwing be. 

 Mr Best eagerquietly lifted his book to say: 

 — That's very interesting because that brother motive, don't you
